title: Quantum-Inspired Balanced Search and Indexing for the Traveling Salesman Problem in C
topic: Improved Quantum Algorithms for TSP and More
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a quantum-inspired implementation of the Held-Karp dynamic-programming algorithm for the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) that leverages a balanced search and indexing structure to reduce memory traffic and improve spatially localized traversal. The design preserves a strict height-balanced invariant over the implicit binary decision tree and maintains key-ordered access to the distance matrix. Empirical evaluation on an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor (1 physical core, 2 logical threads) yields a mean latency of 609.98 \textmu{}s ($\pm$19.96 \textmu{}s) and a throughput of 1,639,388 ops/s over 30 benchmark iterations. The source code is available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/c-lowlevel-systems/tree/main/algorithms/20261126_030235_improved_quantum_algorithms_fo}.
